scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The empty comic
scenes.caption: The group opens its comic: an empty page. Someone accidentally replaced the project, and the change reached the synchronised folder too. Kabir says there must be a backup because the file appears on two devices.
scenes.dialogue: Two matching copies may share one mistake.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: Copies need a history
scenes.caption: Synchronisation keeps locations aligned and may spread an accidental replacement. A useful backup preserves a recoverable copy separately; some services also keep earlier versions. The class must inspect the supplied history rather than assume that every synced folder offers recovery.
scenes.dialogue: What version does each copy contain?

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Read the recovery cards
scenes.caption: The simulation offers an empty current copy, an unreadable snapshot and a checked yesterday version with six panels. Yesterday's version lacks today's new ending. A sensible recovery plan uses the best verified copy while acknowledging the work that may need rebuilding.
scenes.dialogue: A date alone is not enough.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Choose a restore
scenes.caption: Decide whether to overwrite everything immediately, trust the backup label without opening it, or restore the checked version into a separate test location. Keeping the original state while testing avoids turning an uncertain recovery into another accidental replacement.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: Verify the result
scenes.caption: Meera opens the restored project, checks the six panels and confirms the captions are readable. This demonstrates that this copy restored successfully in this test. It does not guarantee every future restore or recover the ending that was never captured.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: An older but complete copy
scenes.caption: Now a newer snapshot has two panels; an older one has the required six. Compare content and time. Record your selected version, verification checks and remaining limitations in a recovery log.
scenes.dialogue: Newest is not always most useful.
